description: This file defines the EntityUniqueProperty class, which implements a validation rule to ensure that a specified property of an entity (likely a database entity) is unique within the context of the application. It interacts with a query builder to check for existing entities with the given property value, considering additional match and ignore values.

classes.name: EntityUniqueProperty
classes.description: A validation rule class that checks for the uniqueness of a specific entity property within the database, considering additional match and ignore conditions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EntityUniqueProperty with entity name, property, and optional match/ignore options.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs the validation to check whether the entity property value is unique according to the specified options.
